title_en: Amazon Vine Guide: Eligibility, Fees and How to Launch With Reviews
title_zh: Amazon Vine 完全指南：资格、费用与新品出评节奏
desc_en: How Amazon Vine works: who qualifies, the $0/$75/$200 enrollment fees per parent product, when you are charged, how many units to offer, and a launch checklist.
desc_zh: 详解 Amazon Vine：参加资格、按父体收取的 0/75/200 美元报名费、何时扣费、送多少件合适、如何安排 FBA 入仓与上新节奏，以及使用 Vine 时必须遵守的评论合规规则，并附一份新品出评操作清单。
body_en:
A new Amazon listing with zero reviews struggles to convert, and you can't buy or swap reviews without breaking Amazon's rules and the law. Amazon Vine is the official way to get early, honest reviews from trusted reviewers. This guide covers who can use it, what it costs, how the timing works and how to avoid wasting units.

What Amazon Vine is

Vine invites a group of trusted Amazon reviewers, called Vine Voices, to request free units of your product and post honest reviews. You don't choose the reviewers and you can't influence the rating. Amazon says products enrolled in Vine see sales rise by an average of 30%, based on its internal data, according to Amazon's Vine page.

Who can use Vine

  • A Professional selling account (currently $39.99 a month plus selling fees, per Amazon).
  • A Brand Representative or Reseller role for a brand enrolled in Amazon Brand Registry, or generic products in your catalog.
  • Eligible FBA offers. The listing must use Fulfillment by Amazon, and inventory must be in Amazon fulfillment centers to ship to Vine Voices.
  • Fewer than 30 reviews on the product detail page, plus an image and description.
  • Not eligible: adult, digital and bundled products.

Vine is available in the US, Canada, UK, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Australia and Japan stores.

What it costs

Amazon charges a one-time enrollment fee per parent product, based on how many units you offer. Child variations under the same parent add no extra fee.

Store3–10 units11–30 units
US$75$200
CanadaCAD 100CAD 240
UKGBP 60GBP 140
EU storesEUR 70EUR 170
JapanJPY 10,000JPY 22,000

Source: Amazon, sell.amazon.com Vine page (accessed Oct 27, 2026). Up to 2 units is free in every listed store. Fees can change; check Seller Central before enrolling.

Key billing rules from Amazon:

  • You aren't charged until 30 days after enrollment and after your first Vine review is published.
  • If you don't get a Vine review within 90 days of enrollment, you aren't charged.
  • New sellers enrolling a brand in Brand Registry receive a $200 Vine credit. See our guide to Brand Registry growth tools.

Remember the real cost is higher than the fee: you also give away the units, and pay to make and ship them to FBA.

How to choose the number of units

  • Testing a product or tight on cash: enroll up to 2 units for free.
  • Standard launch: 3–10 units for $75 can give you a modest base of early reviews.
  • Competitive category or main hero SKU: 11–30 units for $200 builds a stronger base, as long as you're confident in the product.
Vine reviewers are honest. If the product has a weakness, Vine will find it fast and in public. Fix packaging, instructions and quality problems before enrolling, not after.

Timing your Vine launch

Amazon advises having inventory in the fulfillment network at least three weeks before your planned launch date. A practical sequence:

  1. Finalize the listing: images, title, bullets and A+ content.
  2. Ship FBA inventory, including enough units for Vine plus early sales.
  3. Enroll in Vine as soon as inventory is available, choosing your unit count (up to 30).
  4. Start Sponsored Products ads while reviews arrive, but keep budgets modest until the rating settles.
  5. Read every Vine review and fix any recurring issue in the listing or product.

Rules to respect

Don't contact Vine reviewers, ask for positive reviews, or combine Vine with any review incentive outside Amazon's programs. Amazon's rules and the US FTC fake reviews rule both target fake and incentivized reviews. Vine works because Amazon controls the process; keep it that way.

Vine checklist

  1. Confirm Professional account, Brand Registry role and FBA offer.
  2. Check the product has fewer than 30 reviews and isn't a bundle.
  3. Decide units: 2 (free), 3–10 ($75) or 11–30 ($200) per parent.
  4. Get inventory into FBA at least three weeks before launch.
  5. Track reviews for 90 days and act on feedback.

body_zh:
新 Listing 零评论很难转化，而买评、换评既违反亚马逊规则也触犯法律。Amazon Vine 是官方提供的早期评论渠道，由可信评论人给出真实评价。本文讲清楚谁能用、要花多少钱、时间怎么安排，以及如何避免浪费样品。

Amazon Vine 是什么

Vine 会邀请一批受信任的亚马逊评论人（Vine Voices）免费申领你的产品并发布真实评价。你不能挑选评论人，也不能影响评分。据亚马逊 Vine 官方页面，基于亚马逊内部数据，参加 Vine 的产品销量平均提升 30%。

谁能参加

  • 专业卖家账户（据亚马逊，目前月费 39.99 美元，另加销售佣金）。
  • 品牌代表或经销商角色，且品牌已加入亚马逊品牌注册（Brand Registry）；或目录中的无品牌通用产品。
  • 符合条件的 FBA 报价。Listing 须选择 FBA 配送，库存需在亚马逊运营中心才能寄给 Vine 评论人。
  • 评论少于 30 条，且详情页有图片和描述。
  • 不可参加：成人用品、数字商品和捆绑商品。

Vine 目前开放于美国、加拿大、英国、法国、德国、意大利、西班牙、澳大利亚和日本站。

费用是多少

亚马逊按父体收取一次性报名费，金额取决于你提供的件数；同一父体下的子体不另收费。

站点3–10 件11–30 件
美国75 美元200 美元
加拿大100 加元240 加元
英国60 英镑140 英镑
欧盟站点70 欧元170 欧元
日本10,000 日元22,000 日元

来源：Amazon sell.amazon.com Vine 页面（2026 年 10 月 27 日访问）。以上站点最多 2 件均免费。费用可能调整，报名前请以卖家后台为准。

亚马逊的扣费规则：

  • 报名满 30 天且首条 Vine 评论发布后才扣费。
  • 报名后 90 天内没有收到 Vine 评论，不收费。
  • 新卖家在品牌注册中登记品牌，可获得 200 美元 Vine 抵扣额度。详见我们的品牌注册增长工具一文。

注意，真实成本不只是报名费：送出的样品本身、生产成本和发 FBA 的头程运费都要算进去。

件数怎么选

  • 测款或资金紧张：报 2 件，免费。
  • 常规新品：3–10 件、75 美元，可以积累一批早期评论。
  • 竞争激烈的类目或主推款：11–30 件、200 美元，打下更扎实的评论基础——前提是你对产品有信心。
Vine 评论人非常直接。产品有短板，Vine 会很快、而且公开地指出来。包装、说明书和质量问题要在报名前解决，而不是之后。

Vine 上新节奏

亚马逊建议在计划上线日期至少三周前让库存进入配送网络。实操顺序：

  1. 完善 Listing：图片、标题、五点描述和 A+ 内容。
  2. 发 FBA 库存，数量要覆盖 Vine 样品和早期销量。
  3. 库存可售后立即报名 Vine，选择件数（最多 30 件）。
  4. 评论陆续到来时启动 SP 广告，但在评分稳定前控制预算。
  5. 逐条阅读 Vine 评论，针对反复出现的问题优化 Listing 或产品。

必须遵守的规则

不要联系 Vine 评论人，不要索要好评，也不要在亚马逊官方项目之外叠加任何评论激励。亚马逊规则和美国FTC 虚假评论规定都严厉打击虚假和激励性评论。Vine 之所以有效，正是因为全流程由亚马逊控制。

Vine 清单

  1. 确认专业卖家账户、品牌注册角色和 FBA 报价。
  2. 确认产品评论少于 30 条且不是捆绑商品。
  3. 确定件数：2 件（免费）、3–10 件（75 美元）或 11–30 件（200 美元），按父体计。
  4. 上线前至少三周把库存发进 FBA。
  5. 90 天内持续跟踪评论并根据反馈改进。
